title: SEC3: g_tls_safe_mode name obscures its effect
description: The global g_tls_safe_mode (crypto2dev_port.c:343) is named after the motivation (TLS safety) rather than what it actually does: suppress hardware hash dispatch and return CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE. A reader encountering 'if (g_tls_safe_mode) return CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE' in wc_crypto2dev_cb must consult the distant comment on the global declaration to understand the effect. A name like g_hash_sw_fallback or g_suppress_hw_hash would make the code self-documenting at the call site.
